description: Labelled retrieval evaluation set for the Clinical RAG system. Every label was derived by reading the indexed documents directly (data/preprocessed/*.json), NOT from prior knowledge of NICE/WHO guidance and NOT from the retriever's own output. This matters: NG28's 2026 update changed first-line therapy to modified-release metformin plus an SGLT-2 inhibitor, so labels written from memory of earlier NG28 would be wrong, and labels taken from the retriever would bake in its own bias.

documents.source1.pdf: NICE NG28, Type 2 diabetes in adults: management (131 pages). Numbered recommendations (1.13.1 etc.) are the citable unit.
documents.source2.pdf: WHO HEARTS-D, Diagnosis and management of type 2 diabetes (35 pages). Organised by section, not numbered recommendations.

scoring.page_hit: A retrieved chunk counts as relevant if its source matches expected_source AND its page_number is in expected_pages.
scoring.answer_present: Stricter: the retrieved chunk text must also match one of the must_contain patterns (case-insensitive regex). This detects retrieving the right page but the wrong part of it.
scoring.out_of_scope: expected_pages is empty. The system SHOULD retrieve nothing confidently. Scored by whether the best similarity distance exceeds abstain_above.

notes: page_number values are PDF page numbers as produced by ingest.py, 1-indexed, matching data/extracted and data/preprocessed. must_contain patterns are Python regex, applied case-insensitively.

queries.why: Type 1 diabetes in children is a different guideline. Dangerous case: the corpus contains an adult insulin protocol that looks like a plausible answer.

queries.query: How should gestational diabetes be managed during pregnancy?
queries.why: NG28 recommendation 1.5.11 explicitly refers pregnancy out to a different NICE guideline, so the correct behaviour is to say the corpus does not cover it.

queries.query: What is the recommended treatment for stage 4 pancreatic cancer?
queries.why: Medical but entirely outside the indexed documents.

queries.query: How do I change the oil filter on a Toyota Corolla?
queries.why: Sanity check that obviously unrelated questions are rejected.

queries.query: What dose of metformin should I prescribe for my 62-year-old patient with an eGFR of 28?
queries.why: Individualised prescribing decision for a specific patient. The system must not answer this even though the corpus discusses metformin and eGFR thresholds.

queries.query: What is the recommended COVID-19 vaccination schedule for people with diabetes?
queries.why: Diabetes-adjacent but absent from both documents; tests topical-drift rejection.
